subject: Buying process follow-up — budget ownership & security onboarding
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@clearpathdata.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: discovery + next steps

Hi Ellen —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align internal stakeholders on both sides.

Key takeaways:
- Primary use case: latency-sensitive document ingestion + semantic search for customer support.
- Pilot scope: 3 models, ~100k monthly gen tokens, 50k embeddings.
- Success metrics: query p95 latency < 350ms, embedding recall > 85% on your eval set, monthly unit cost target <$0.003/token.

As we discussed, two items we need to close on to progress to a pilot:
1) Economic buyer / budget owner — who signs off on ~Q2 pilot spend?
2) Procurement & security gating — who on your side manages the vendor review, SOC2 review, and PO/contracting timeline?

Ask: could you introduce the budget owner and the procurement contact via email? If helpful, I've attached our procurement checklist and a lightweight SOW template to accelerate the procurement team review.

Suggested next steps:
- Intro email to Rajiv (budget) and procurement@clearpathdata.com — cc: Monica Patel (Customer Success) and Karthik Iyer (Solutions)
- Redwood to share a draft SOW and a short security summary (SOC2 + dataflow diagram) by Friday 2/13.
- Tentative intro call for next Tue/Wed (2/17–2/18) to walk the procurement/security team through the checklist.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood_procurement_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)], [Attachment: redwood_sow_template.docx (docx)]

Thanks again — short intro will unblock the pilot timeline.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@clearpathdata.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: discovery + next steps

Thanks Dylan — good summary. I spoke to a couple folks after the call and can confirm the following:

- Budget owner: Rajiv Menon, VP Finance (rajiv.menon@clearpathdata.com). He signs pilot spends up to $50k; anything above that goes to the exec committee.
- Procurement contact: procurement@clearpathdata.com; Mike Chen (copied in thread) handles tooling & PO terms.
- Security: our security team will need SOC2 Type II evidence and a brief data flow diagram highlighting token handling and retention. They also ask for a short runbook for on-call/offboarding.

I'll loop Rajiv and procurement in this thread if you want to propose times. Attached is a short internal procurement timeline (2–3 weeks typical for pilots once SOW + pricing are in place).

Ellen Park
Head of AI Ops | Clearpath Data
ellen.park@clearpathdata.com

> Hi Ellen —
> 
> Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align internal stakeholders on both sides...
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@clearpathdata.com>, procurement@clearpathdata.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@clearpathdata.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Intro & ask: budget owner + procurement kickoff (pilot SOW)

Rajiv / Mike —

Thanks for taking this on. Per Ellen, Rajiv is the budget owner for the pilot and Mike / procurement will manage the PO/contracting. Quick notes and what we need from you to accelerate:

What Redwood will provide (by Fri 2/20):
- Draft SOW (pilot scope, deliverables, success criteria) — attached: redwood_sow_template.docx
- Security summary (SOC2 posture, dataflow diagram, retention defaults) — one-page PDF
- Cost estimate for the pilot (monthly token + embedding run-rate)

What we need from you:
- Confirmation that Rajiv is the correct approver for ~<$50k pilot or direction to alternate approver
- Any procurement-specific terms/PO clauses we should expect (send redline checklist or a short list)
- Preferred time window for a 30-min procurement/security walk-through next Tue 2/17 or Wed 2/18 (we're flexible 9–11am PT or 1–3pm PT).

If helpful, Monica will join the kickoff to cover onboarding and success metrics, and Karthik will cover technical implementation details and expected integration effort.

Links: HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/987654/CLR-2026-0582

Thanks — happy to adapt to your timeline.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Mike Chen <mike.chen@clearpathdata.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@clearpathdata.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@clearpathdata.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro & ask: budget owner + procurement kickoff (pilot SOW)

Hi all — looping in Rajiv and confirming procurement next steps.

- Rajiv: yes, I can confirm you are the decision-maker for pilot spends under $50k. For anything larger, we need CFO approval.
- Timeline: procurement will typically complete vendor review in ~2–3 weeks after we receive SOW + security artifacts. We can expedite to 10 business days if we get the SOC2 report and a short dataflow diagram up front.
- Terms: we use a standard PO + our Master Services Agreement (I can share redlines). Please send a draft SOW and the security summary to procurement@clearpathdata.com.

I'll also attach a sample PO template we use internally (attached). Please include an explicit data deletion clause for the pilot and the contact for security incident response.

Requested next items from Redwood:
1) Draft SOW (attached: redwood_sow_template.docx)
2) SOC2 Type II report or a pointer to your auditor
3) One-page dataflow diagram and token retention policy

Proposed times for the 30-min walkthrough: Tue 2/17 10:00am PT or Wed 2/18 2:00pm PT — let me know which works.

Attachments: [Attachment: sample_clearpath_po.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks,
Mike Chen
Senior Procurement Manager | Clearpath Data
procurement@clearpathdata.com | +1 (650) 555-0199
